messages:
maria: Quick question for design review: for Private deployments, what's our minimal tamper-evident evidence chain that proves RBAC changes + KMS rotations werent tampered with during an incident? :thinking:
liam: We should emit append-only signed manifests for RBAC changes and key rotations. Sign with a KMS/HSM-backed key and store public key snapshots per epoch.
jamal: Agree. Also link each RBAC event to a key-rotation event id so auditors can trace timelines.
jen_sre: Ops constraint: customers want low-touch. Can we automate daily bundles and keep an offline root for cross-signing?
liam: Yes. Approach: sidecar watches authz writes -> audit-writer builds daily bundle {events.json, role_snapshots/, key_rotations.json, signatures.txt} -> sign bundle with tenant KMS key -> upload to immutable path /evidence/<tenant>/<date>/bundle.tgz. Store cross-signed epoch root in an immutable store.
maria: Nice. How do we surface to customers? Console + downloadable artifact + SIEM forward?
jen_sre: Console for quick verification, S3 export (immutable) for retention, and syslog/SIEM forward (allowlist fields only) for real-time monitoring.
jamal: Important: when KMS rotates, old signatures must still verify. Keep public key material (or cert chain) per rotation epoch and include fingerprint in manifest.
maria: For incident triage checklist: 1) verify S3 object version + checksums, 2) validate signatures against epoch pubkey, 3) cross-check RBAC event ids to authz WAL, 4) confirm key policy commits in repo.
jen_sre: Also provide role-snapshot diffs to speed triage (small JSON delta).
liam: Edge case: suspected HSM compromise. Playbook: publish signed revocation manifest (signed with offline root), revoke signing keys, preserve existing bundles as forensic evidence, notify customers with revocation fingerprint.
jamal: I'll build a POC sidecar that emits signed bundles + a verification script. 2 sprint points.
maria: @jamal include an e2e test simulating key rotation to ensure historic signatures still verify.
jen_sre: I'll draft a short runbook snippet and schedule a tabletop next week. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created SEC ticket SEC-4321 and added to eng-security board. References: https://intra.redwood/priv/audit-runbook
